correction.note: The first audit reported 312866 violations. That was a DEFECT IN THE AUDIT, not in the strategy. Two causes: (1) it re-derived pools over the whole 360-bar evaluation slice while evaluateV2 builds pools from visible.slice(-lookback) (300 bars), so it compared a different pool set; (2) it flagged ANY target lying merely NEAR a taken pool, but only INTERNAL_LIQUIDITY rungs are pool-sourced - EQUILIBRIUM (range mid), RANGE_EDGE (far boundary) and R_MULTIPLE are geometric levels and accounted for 245783 of the flags.
correction.directUnitEvidence: tests/real-data-tooling.test.ts asserts buildTargets excludes SWEPT/CONSUMED pools and admits resting ones, for both LONG and SHORT.
